crossRefs.note: David said to him, “Will you bring me down to this troop?” He said, “Swear to me by God that you will not kill me and…
Don’t stand in the crossroads to cut off those of his who escape. Don’t deliver up those of his who remain in the day…

translations.web: You shall not deliver to his master a servant who has escaped from his master to you.
translations.bsb: Do not return a slave to his master if he has taken refuge with you.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not deliver unto his master the servant which is escaped from his master
translations.asv: Thou shalt not deliver unto his master a servant that is escaped from his master unto thee:
